switching_measure: Unweighted settled changes over all learned gate outputs in saved validation order divided by gate count times adjacent-image pairs
checkpoint: Final epoch of a matched fixed training budget
comparison: One matched model seed at a time, including the lambda-zero control as a selectable candidate
budget_rationale: Working experimental tolerance of one percentage point; not a professor requirement or a demonstrated Pareto optimum. Freeze before meaningful training; use a separately named policy for a different tolerance.

future_hardware_controls.workload: Match image order and valid schedule within each hardware comparison

limits: Software validation selection does not establish hardware feasibility, glitch reduction, power, energy or novelty. The already inspected digits test remains exploratory. Repeated-seed aggregation is a later experimental step.
